subject.title: fix(browser): check own profile entries for profile operations

question: Should OpenClaw accept a merge-patch exception that allows the blocked key `constructor` only at `browser.profiles.constructor` after the test type error is fixed?
rationale: The exception is narrowly scoped and tested, but it deliberately changes a prototype-pollution guard, so final acceptance needs maintainer security-boundary ownership rather than only CI.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Fix the test type error, rerun focused validation, and accept the scoped exception as the compatibility fix for valid browser profile names.

options.title: Require no blocked-key exception
options.body: Pause the PR and ask for a representation or validation change that never permits a blocked object key through merge-patch.

options.title: Defer to security owner review
options.body: Keep the branch open while a security-boundary owner decides whether this profile-key compatibility case is allowed.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the test type error, rerun focused validation, and accept the scoped exception as the compatibility fix for valid browser profile names.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected current-main lines and originating merged work point most strongly to `steipete`, making him the best available routing owner for the boundary choice.
